sources.title: GLM-4.7-Flash: How To Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-4.7-Flash is Z.ai's new 30B MoE reasoning model built for local deployment, delivering best-in-class performance for coding, agentic workflows, and chat. It uses ~3.6B parameters, supports 200K context, and leads SWE-Bench, GPQA, and reasoning/chat benchmarks.
